checks.Definition: CHECK (((outcome)::text = ANY (ARRAY[('ANSWERED'::character varying)::text, ('REFUSED'::character varying)::text, ('INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE'::character varying)::text, ('FAILED'::character varying)::text])))

checks.Name: ck_agent_runs_tool_and_citation_json_valid
